name: Hamor
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: The sons of Jacob answered deceitfully: every male of the city must be circumcised before they would consent. Hamor and Shechem persuaded the whole city, reasoning that the wealth of Jacob's house would become theirs; every male was circumcised.

note.label: Genesis 34: Dinah and the Zeal of Simeon and Levi

points: The bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, they buried in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver, and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

note.label: Joshua 24: Choose You This Day Whom Ye Will Serve

points: Gaal talked big: who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him? He asked why they should be serving this Israelite at all.

note.label: Judges 9: Abimelech and the Fire Out of the Bramble
